gloss: many fields; various directions; many aspects

definitions.gloss: many fields; many areas; various directions
definitions.explanation: Refers to multiple areas, fields, or directions. Used when something extends across or comes from many different areas.

examples.japanese: {多方面|たほうめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: To gather opinions from many quarters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多方面|たほうめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is active in many fields.

examples.japanese: {多方面|たほうめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: With her knowledge spanning many fields, she can engage with any topic.

notes:
Composed of {多|た} (many) + ⟦{方面|ほうめん}→方面：12335_houmen⟧ (direction, field, area). Can refer to literal multiple directions or figurative multiple fields of activity or expertise. Often used with particles ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, から, or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多方面|たほうめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる — spanning many areas
- {多方面|たほうめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧ — to be active in many fields
- {多方面|たほうめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — from many quarters/directions
- {多方面|たほうめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧ — to affect many areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多面的|ためんてき}→多面的：19703_tamenteki⟧ — multifaceted; adjective describing something with many aspects
- {各方面|かくほうめん} — various quarters, all directions; emphasizes 'each' rather than 'many'
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧ — wide-ranging, broad; more everyday term
